end_state: Automaton OS speaks plain English and stops leading with operator dashboards. In ap-web/src: (1) a new module src/lib/copy.ts exports a single mapping from internal vocabulary to user-facing wording and every user-visible string in the six AOS pages (SystemPage, FleetPage, PatternsPage, ModelsPage, LoopsPage, TrainingPage), PageShell, Sidebar and WorkLoopPanel is routed through it — at minimum: warden is removed entirely, automaton/automata become 'saved routine'/'routines', execution becomes 'run', 'MCP servers' becomes 'connected apps', ghost dispatch becomes 'never started', last_heartbeat becomes 'last seen' with a relative time, context_pct becomes 'memory used' as a whole percent, run-weighted/unweighted become 'across all runs'/'average per routine', fail-closed becomes 'stops if a check fails', receipt becomes 'proof of what was done', gate becomes 'needs your OK', exit codes 0/3/6 become 'finished'/'paused for input'/'failed a check', and Mtok becomes 'per million words'; (2) no raw error detail from the AMS bridge reaches a user — lib/ams.ts stops JSON.stringify-ing the detail field, and every page that catches an AmsError renders a plain sentence plus a Retry control that re-runs the fetch; (3) the sidebar's primary navigation is reduced to three destinations — Do (the chat route), Work (the inbox route) and Advanced — with System, Fleet, Patterns, Models, Loops and Training reachable from inside the Advanced tab rather than as top-level items, and the existing routes continuing to work so no deep link breaks; (4) the Models role picker becomes keyboard operable — the role node gets tabIndex and an onKeyDown handler that activates on Enter and Space. Changes are confined to ap-web/src. The TypeScript build and the vitest suite both pass. THE BRAND IDENTITY IS PRESERVED EXACTLY: the Automaton OS wordmark, the wolf mascot, the gold-on-dark theme and the 'Let's do this thing!' hero remain untouched on the landing surface. This phase changes wording and navigation placement only, never the visual identity.
inspection_criteria: No file outside ap-web/src was modified.
No test was deleted or skipped to make the suite pass.
Every deep link that worked before still resolves.
The word 'warden' appears in no user-visible string.
Each error state offers a retry.
The wolf mascot, wordmark, gold-on-dark theme and hero slogan are unchanged.
All six operator pages are reachable from the Advanced tab.
blocked_conditions: The nav reduction would break an existing route or test that cannot be legitimately updated.
A required change would need edits outside ap-web/src.
The vitest suite cannot pass without removing a test asserting correct behaviour.
Preserving the brand identity conflicts with a required navigation change.
